title: GET /api/mxl/v1/meta
description: Version + capability discovery. A skin reads this first to decide whether it can run against this core instance.

api_version.description: The contract major.minor this core serves, e.g. "1.0". Major changes only on breaking changes.

core_version.description: The core release (semver or core-vX.Y.Z tag) running this instance.

capabilities.description: What this instance actually offers. A skin loads only if its required capabilities are a subset of this list.

program_url.description: Opaque embeddable program-video view (WebRTC/WHEP). Media plane, NOT part of the JSON contract — a skin embeds it but assumes nothing beyond 'a program view at this URL'. Absent if no program view is exposed.

required.description: Whether a token is required for mutating (control) routes on this instance.

scopes.description: Scopes this instance understands. One shared token satisfies all; per-scope tokens are future work.

read_required.description: Whether read routes also require a token (MXL_REQUIRE_READ_AUTH). Defaults false.
